name: Koishikawa Kaori
source:
A student at Nadeshiko Production's training school.
The leader of the hometown combination of her [url=/c41196]Yayoi[/url] and [url=/c41195]Hongou[/url].
She's a hardworker, but has a lot of complexes and often talks down to herself.
